detail: First listed in the declaration filed in January 2024 (tportal, Dnevnik Nova TV). Croatian officials file asset declarations (imovinske kartice) with the Commission for the Resolution of Conflicts of Interest, which publishes them in its register of officials on sukobinteresa.hr; the register's individual pages are excluded by the site's robots.txt and could not be read by the harvest, so the figures are taken from established media that reported the published declaration.
